jobs.title: Fullstack Entwickler mit PHP-Backend – Symfony, RabbitMQ (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wer wir sind Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden. Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen, eingebettet in deren Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt ist das Backend: Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse zwischen Systemen und die Logik dahinter. Im Frontend packst du mit an, wenn es das Feature braucht. Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP, bevorzugt Symfony REST-APIs entwerfen und mit OpenAPI dokumentieren Systeme über Messaging verbinden: RabbitMQ, Symfony Messenger oder Kafka GitLab-Pipelines aufbauen und pflegen, vom Build bis zum Deployment Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, Frontend und Betrieb Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Beim Kunden bist du an einzelnen Präsenztagen, zum Beispiel in Berlin an zwei bis drei Tagen im Monat. Wer mag, kommt zusätzlich in eins unserer Büros. Zwang ist das keiner. Wo du landest Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung. Was du mitbringst Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwickler, gezählt nach Ausbildung oder Studium. Das erwarten wir: PHP, mindestens drei Jahre produktiv in den letzten fünf Jahren, bevorzugt mit Symfony (Laravel ist auch in Ordnung) REST-API-Design einschließlich OpenAPI CI/CD mit GitLab-Pipelines Message-basierte Architektur mit RabbitMQ oder Vergleichbarem (Symfony Messenger auf AMQP, Kafka) Automatisierte Tests mit PHPUnit, dazu Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests Von Vorteil (kein Muss): LLM-Integration

jobs.title: Solution Engineer - Vehicle OS
jobs.description: Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co . We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About the role We are looking for a bright engineer to help our customers solve complex technical problems across Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS portfolio. In this role you will work closely with vehicle software and tooling teams at OEMs and Tier 1s to ensure Applied’s solutions deliver maximum impact in advancing customers’ Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) strategies and in-cabin user experiences. Vehicle OS is Applied Intuition’s software platform for SDV. It enables OEMs to modernize their E/E architecture through three interconnected areas: Middleware & architecture Service-oriented, middleware-driven software stacks built on AUTOSA

jobs.description: Your Mission: As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements. jobs.title: Senior BMS Software Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: In this BMS Software Engineer role, you will join the VÆRIDION Airborne Software team within the Technology division. You will be responsible to lead the design of software required for our propulsion battery management and power distribution for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of the High Voltage Propulsion Battery System at the core of VÆRIDION’s novel propulsion system. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the design, development, and implementation of embedded software for propulsion battery and power distribution from prototypes to future airworthy systems. Implement software development processes and toolchains in compliance with aviation standards and regulations. Define and document software requirements, specifications, and interfaces for the high voltage electrical power system. Collaborate closely with cell, electrical, and thermal engineers to integrate algorithms for battery state estimation, cell balancing, fault detection, power control, and thermal management. Conduct thorough testing and validation of the software, including integration testing with other aircraft systems. Support system integration, iron bird/field testing, and certification efforts, providing expertise on software functionality and performance. Stay current with advancements in battery technology, software development methodologies, and aviation regulations. Your Profile: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field. A Master's degree is preferred. Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, with a focus on embedded systems and real-time applications. Minimum of 2 years of experience in software design, with a focus on embedded systems and real-time applications. We are committed to designing and producing cutting-edge electric conventional take-off and landing (eCTOL) aircraft that provide safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly transportation solutions. As a Senior High Voltage Systems Engineer, you will significantly contribute to the design, development, and certification of the aircraft's high voltage systems. You will work as part of a multi-functional team, reporting to the HV Systems Team Lead, and covering HV system development and electrical integration, including battery systems, power electronics, HV EWIS, distribution equipment and associated sub-systems. Your daily tasks will include a variety of technical activities for the HV Electrical Systems team. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team. Define HV system functions, architecture, sizing and specifications, and integrate the aircraft HV distribution system to meet safety and performance requirements. Develop interface control documents (ICDs) covering physical and functional interfaces with the aircraft structure and related systems. Lead technical tasks for Microliner development and certification, and create system documentation from requirements definition to demonstration of compliance. Define aircraft-level HV electrical bonding and grounding requirements and their implementation. jobs.description: Your Mission: As a Principal Structures Materials & Processes Engineer (all genders) you will be responsible for developing and optimizing materials and processes to enhance the performance and safety of aerospace systems. You will be involved in the entire lifecycle of a product, from initial research and development to installation and final commissioning. Your Day-to-Day: Conduct research to develop new and improved manufacturing processes. Develop, modify, and test materials used in the design of aerospace systems. Perform failure analysis and develop solutions to address them. Monitor material performance and evaluate material deterioration. Interpret materials and process specifications in aerospace manufacturing. Research and develop innovative material processing techniques. Ensure materials and processes comply with health, safety, and environmental regulations (e.g. REACH, RoHS) Work closely with design engineers to integrate materials and processes into design. Establish and maintain detailed documentation of materials and processes for future reference and regulatory compliance. Provide technical advice to engineering and manufacturing teams on material selection and process optimization. Your Profile: Master's degree in Materials Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in aerospace materials and processes engineering in at least one aircraft development programs, ideally two programs. Strong understanding of materials properties and manufacturing processes. Proficiency in failure analysis and problem-solving. Ability to work in a multidisciplinary and agile team environment. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Experience with supplier collaboration. Passioned about aviation and electrification of aviation industry. jobs.title: Senior Structures Integration Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Your Mission: As Senior Structures Integration Engineer, (all genders), you will be responsible for key structural design and integration work for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will develop lightweight, manufacturable, safe and certifiable airframe structures from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production-ready release. Your work will cover primary and secondary structures, metallic and composite design and structural integration. You will work closely with Flight Physics, Material and Processes, Systems, Production, Configuration, Certification, Safety and external partners to turn our aircraft architecture into robust, buildable hardware while mentoring junior engineers within your area of expertise. Your Day-to-Day: Independently execute structural integration activities and assigned integration work packages. Coordinate, develop and mature physical interfaces across major airframe assemblies, flight controls, systems, equipment, batteries, landing gear, interiors, and electrical installations. Identify, manage and track the maturity of structural, mechanical, geometric, and equipment installation interfaces. Translate aircraft-level architecture and system requirements into integration constraints, space allocations, interface requirements, and installation design solutions. Be responsible for integration work packages from initial architecture and space allocation through interface definition, design maturity, and released configuration. Prepare and maintain Interface Control Documents, Frontier Package models, space allocation envelopes, keep-out zones, and other integration data. Maintain and mature the aircraft Digital Mock-Up (DMU) and Product Structure, as well as perform clash detection, clearance checks, accessibility assessments, and support zonal analyses. Liaise with internal and external engineering teams to define routing paths, structural provisions, penetrations, cut-outs, and attachment concepts.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. jobs.title: Android Developer
jobs.description: At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with our colleagues, we build technology that takes the burden off patients and healthcare professionals, creating more space for care. As an Android Developer, you will help make this happen by building and improving the mobile applications that connect people, devices and healthcare. We create technology to make healthcare more accessible, as our digital health solutions help healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, so people can receive the right care in the right place. As an Android Developer, you will help us build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible. Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role. The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform. Your role As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.

jobs.title: Manager, Engineering - Product
jobs.description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a product engineering team at ClickUp. This is an open team placement role: you'll join a product team based on your strengths and our business priorities, rather than being hired into a single predefined product area. Across teams, the mandate is the same: build a strong team, ship useful product improvements, and take ownership of the quality and reliability of what you deliver. Engineering Managers at ClickUp are hands-on. You'll lead from the front: reading and reviewing code daily, debugging production issues alongside your team, prototyping when it unblocks a decision, and shipping code yourself when the team needs it. Your technical credibility is how you earn trust, set the bar, and make good calls quickly. You'll also own people management, delivery, and team execution. Working closely with product, design, and technical leads, you'll turn customer problems into clear priorities and achievable milestones. You'll develop engineers, make trade-offs explicit, and keep work moving without letting quality or maintainability become someone else's problem. You'll also run an AI-native team . We structure work so AI agents can read it, route it, roll it up, and report on it. Progress and team health should be visible from real signals, with reporting available self-serve rather than dependent on status meetings. We want a manager who has used AI to remove busywork and improve how a team builds, and who can help engineers use it responsibly across planning, implementation, testing, and operations. jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . The Role We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion. This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. jobs.title: Junior Compute Architect
jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the Hardware organisation at Fractile Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the Software organisation at Fractile PerfSim sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing. About the team and role To build hardware that doesn't yet exist, you first have to model it — with precision, depth, and an eye for the trade-offs that matter. jobs.description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakehold

jobs.title: Senior Hub Developer
jobs.description: We're looking for a developer to grow Ember's network of charging hubs. You'll find the sites, take them through legals and planning, manage the build and energise them. How you work and think matters more to us than which industry you've worked in. You think clearly, can run several projects at once and are as at home on a site as behind a desk. About Ember We're building the future of public transport — convenient, affordable, connected and zero-emission. Our goal is to make it easier and more enjoyable to get from A to B with Ember than it is with your own car. Ember is a tech company, not a traditional bus operator. We've built a platform that coordinates our entire operation — everything from monitoring vehicles and controlling chargers to selling tickets and calculating ETAs. This allows us to use electric buses more intensively than anyone else in the world, leading to a massive reduction in emissions. It also helps us provide a much better passenger experience, with innovative features like demand-responsive stops. We’re still tiny, with a handful of routes and ~100 buses. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
